text_block_list.name: Tomie
text_block_list.text: Hey, sinners! You're lamenting your sins too, aren't you? You need a penalty for your unforgivable sins!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よう
〝罪人〟ども！
主も〝嘆い〟てるぜェ～？
赦されざる〝咎〟には〝罰符〟が必要だってなァ！？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Damn you, the Dark Lord of the Universe plotting to eliminate humanity!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おのれ出たな、
人類抹殺をたくらむ
宇宙暗黒大魔王め！

text_block_list.name: Tomie
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's with all the weirdos? What kind of conspiracy theories are they talking about, turning right around and wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あァ？　
なんだ〝異常者〟ら。
善悪〝逆転〟にして、
なに壮大な〝陰謀論〟ほざいてやが──

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Shut up, Dark Lord of the Universe! We'll protect humanity's peace! Yuni-chan, give it everything you've got!
text_block_list.orig_text:
黙れ、
宇宙暗黒大魔王！
人類の平和は
ぼくらが守る！
ユニちゃんズ、
全力開放だ！

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですね！
なかよし部、
全力開放です！
